en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of an ornate historicist / Art Nouveau building complex bordering a landscaped square with trees and benches. The main facade is richly decorated with balconies, sculptural elements, and towers topped with statues. At the top left of the card, the caption reads "Marienbad. Franz Josephs‑Platz." Additional signage on the buildings includes the word "BANK" and hotel names.
